correct_completion: each one shimmering with a deliberate ambiguity.
full_sentence: Her prose was littered with metaphors, each one shimmering with a deliberate ambiguity.

every image doubling back on itself in meaning.

options.text: each one shimmering with a deliberate ambiguity.

options.why_wrong: This is a bibliographic detail with no stylistic weight, so it breaks the register and does not complete the description.

grammar_focus: Absolute participial phrase modifying a noun phrase in a formal literary register
explanation: The '-ing' participial phrase after the comma works as an absolute modifier that adds a descriptive comment on the metaphors. Learners whose first language tends to use a full finite clause for this function often produce an additional verb instead of a participle.
translation: Su prosa estaba salpicada de metáforas, cada una brillando con una ambigüedad deliberada.
